# GAOS v0.26.0 — canonical identity and product-neutral SDK

v0.26.0 completes the coordinated Game-Agent Open Standard rename and moves
product-specific Arena/Zonoid behavior out of the standard SDK.

## Highlights

- Canonical TypeScript package: `@yugao-gaos/gaos-sdk`
- Canonical Python distribution/import: `gaos-sdk` / `gaos_sdk`
- Canonical hosted protocol: `gaos.ticks` v1
- Canonical standalone schema namespace and GAOS Pages `$id` domain
- Product-neutral TypeScript and Python `SessionClient` APIs
- Arena/Zonoid adapters moved to the Zonoid product repository
- Explicit public entry points and automated dependency-boundary enforcement

## Breaking migration

Replace `@yugao-gaos/turn-based-grid-sdk` with
`@yugao-gaos/gaos-sdk`, replace `agilabs_arena` imports with `gaos_sdk`, and
replace `agilabs.ticks` with `gaos.ticks`.

The generic client keeps product observations and commands opaque. Zonoid
consumers that need `ArenaClient`, `AsyncArenaClient`, or `ArenaEnv` should use
the product-owned `@agilabs/arena-adapter` or `zonoid-gaos-adapter`
(`zonoid_gaos`) packages.

Standalone `agilabs.*` schema identities move to `gaos.*`. Existing
`gaos.replay` v1.0–v1.3 artifacts remain valid and must not be rewritten.

See the [complete migration guide](https://yugao-gaos.github.io/GAOS-SDK/releases#v0260).
